svg.text: An edit is applied in one commit: the effects, in tree order
Before, in the World query. roomSlots.ensure draws the room ids for the CPU, read during render,
and queues them for the GPU. A new map uploads them at once: nothing of it is on screen yet.
LayoutSync, placed before the floor
roomSlots.upload() sends the queued room ids. Only an edit queues them, so then onEditMap:
doorway tracking cleared, npcs put in their rooms, lit rooms and the rooms' fade resynced (snapped)
out of step: a flash of old floor, a black frame, or a dark map
Floor and ceiling
redraw from the new layout, every geomorph at once on an edit
later: the old floor shows under the new walls
Walls and obstacles
new instances. Obstacles found their rooms during render, from the CPU room ids
without those room ids: every obstacle never shown, so black tops
Decor
rebuildStatic, for a new layout of the map it has built (builtMapKey): rooms, keys, grid,
instances and switch tints, then raycasts, physics and decor-ready. No images needed
left to its query: the removed sub-symbol's switches linger over the empty floor
After, not holding the view. The navmesh arrives from its worker, and the floor redraws
its mesh lines. Physics rebuilds, and its reply re-adds decor's colliders. Spots arrive seconds later.
A new map instead: the decor query loads images and materials, then runs rebuildStatic itself.
